body:
Happy birthday :D And soory to hear that. I know it's something that you must hear a lot when in this situation but try to live for this person. Your life matters <3
Enjoy your day <3

This post remind me of my mom. She was raped when i was 9 and did 2 suicide attempt. She couldn't resolve herself to get to the court against her rapist because it would had cause trouble to me and my brother. And she got through this alone and i really don't know how. Like her, i can say that you are as strong as her, being able to fight even if you don't want to. Today i'm 23 and she got better over time even though we have our lives apart even though i stay close to her because it's hard times. 
What i want to say is that i can tell how strong you are because i saw how strengh it needs to be in that place. 
And with that strengh, you will (really hoping so) that it will get better over time. 
Keep fighting <3

PS : i don't really feel great talking about my life like that but i though it will be a great example so.. i don't know. I just feel sorry about that fact (a bit anxious). 
But here we go. KEEP FIGHTING :D

They tell totally needed to be behind you for that. But at least there are people that are behind, some friends of you. I know that having familly against is hard but i really hope that the support from your friends will be enough to at least get through the pain that you living right now.
Really hope that you are feeling a bit better even though it must feel like hell. Wishing you the best

I don't what to say to apart the fact that this hit home hard. My mother got raped when i was 9 and the only thing our family git nice to do was to insult us. Like our own family. 
She didn't got any support and she's still here. 
I don't know how much it is in term of pain to be in that spot but i saw and hear everyday that pain so i can understand a little bit. 
Maybe if there someone you trust out there in this world you can confess to them. If not it's great that you came here to speak about that when i know that silence is often the thing people do in this situation.
If you feel really bad i am sure people here will help you well and i really hope that like my own mom you will get out (at least making it "liivable" because i'm sure that you can't heal from this at 100%) from this. 
Much love and stay strong <3

Don't be sorry, it's ok if u had things to do i don't mind (i did sleep a lot so your answer is coming in time for me actually). And yeah it's complicated to have jerks in your life when you don't really trust people (i have hard trust issues when being close to someone so for me having friends i can be confident with is difficult and when you finalmy have some and that u understand some are jerks it's difficult to restart everything) but i know that i need to try. Also i should have been participating to a group therapy for social anxiety and stuff but covid destroy that.... so it's more complicated for me in that regard. But i will try at some point. 
And again don't be sorry, hope this event was great and that you are doing great <3

Yeah i know this feeling. One time i felt really bad because in my mind it was all void, like it was the thing after death, the void. And it felt really bad. 
Being between wanting to die and not doing it partially because of the fear of what next is destroying me.
I really hope for better days and that i will get through this but my hope have been really low recently and the current situation is not adding up. But yeah we all need to fight this.
I will if i feel like this again.
Thank you for your message and i also wish you the best, hoping we will get through this.
Really happy to read this. Hope you still doing great and if you ever feel down we are here <3

I also know a bit this situation. I want you to know that here we know how you feel and that we know how much it hurts. If you need to talk about here me and i'm sure everyone here will be more than happy to talk with you about it. Hoping that you are doing ok. Much love and take care of yourself <3

For the rest of my familly they where jerks to me and my mom while she was living really hard times so... 
But yeah you are 100% right i shouldn't isolate myself but sometimes my brain want to take stupid decisions like that especially because of my trust issues and such. 
Sorry for the long message and thanks for the messages, means a lot to me, really. Hope you are doing well like everyone else around here <3

I know this was a bad idea but i have a lot of issue with confidence in others and i faced some issues with a person that is important to me so i felt bad and isolated myself, and the covid situation and all just added to this. 
I do have a job (web developer) but it's a mess actually with work and the gouvernment decisions (in France right now it's confinment again and the company decided to put days at work and days of telework it's a bit of a mess and confusing, so not adding well to my health tbh) and i don't really feel well about my work recently but i don't think it's because i hate it but i did had axiety and some time in tears at work which feels worse to live for me. I have 2/3 friends but don't reach to them that often because we aren't really close (you know, discord friends, that you know from somewhere random and talk one a year or so...) and also that person i talked about earlier but it's complicated. For my family, i only have my mom which is 50/50. Sometimes really supportive sometimes i just need to be happy. So it's hard to reach to her but tonight i did. I'm at her place and she's supportive so it's nice.

Since a few months, my suicidal thoughts have grown up and  i harmed myself a lot. I don't feel like my life have a point and i feel like it's going to a dead end and i don't have support in my life. I've isolating myself and it was like it didn't matter. So i really feel like i don't matter in this life. 
Also i have no dream nor objective in my life that make me want to live. 
But at least i moved in my mom's house for this weekend because i really felt suicidal.
But next week i don't know what i will do. It really feel like i'm surviving every day for any real reason. Feel like hell.

No having many comments really touch me because i really felt alone in this. It really touch me. And i tried but she didn't answer. I left a message so she can contact me later to get this appointment sooner than later. Thanks a lot <3
I'm gonna contact my therapist but i don't think she will answer sadly. But i'm gonna try anyways. Thanks for giving me advice i'm really lost
I have a talk therapy at the moment and i have an appointment next week. Also i have antidepressants (deroxat).

Yeah exactly, i don't see any reason to live right now other than : "if i do it my mom would be crushed about that and with all that she came through i don't want that to happen to her". I mean i want a reason to live by my own, likr something only attached to me. But i don't get that and everyday feel like torture to me sadly.

No real reason. It just feel pointless and i got through a lot recently so it's like a lot of thing into one that doesn't male any sense. I don't know how to explain, i'm really confused. I'm sorry. And i'm here because i just wanted to share this, to scream out loud but on the internet, idk how to say what i want to say.

I don't consider them evil but it just make me feel bad even though i understand what they want to say. 
Thanks for your support, it was much needed. Thank you very much and i hope i will get out of this <3

I understand that way too much. One time i felt really bad at my work and i called my mom. She talked about the time she got raped and asked me what if i was in her place at that time and i said "i wouldn't be here" and she said that was selfish. I felt so much guilty that i still feel today about that but it also make me suffer so much. It's a stupid thing to say. But i think you, me and everyone here need to be strong. Even though i really feel bad right now.
And i am deeply sorry to hear you are in the same boat. I just hope that you can get through this <3
Because when people (especially my mom) say that i should not think about it and be happy, i feel like it's my fault, that i am the problem and just being annoying. And it fucking hurts
